notes: True 24h workload inventory for BurstGPT day0 raw replay on minimax/minimax-m3. MiniMax_Plus_SQ uses OpenRouter-pinned Minimax for physical requests while preserving MiniMax Plus subscription quota windows and one-day fixed-cost accounting; Featherless_SC is the paper's per-process Featherless Premium slot. Model switched from m2.5 on 2026-09-14 because OpenRouter lists only 7 providers for m2.5 (six of the paper's eight pins dropped the model) but 13 for m3, at the same $0.30/$1.20 price point for most; the six-provider API pool (Together, GMICloud, Minimax, AtlasCloud, Novita, StreamLake) came from a 10-minute uniform probe survey of all thirteen. Excluded: CoreWeave (fastest and cheapest, would absorb all API traffic), Parasail and DeepInfra (heavy per-key 429s), Venice (30-40 s stalls), Mara (broken), SambaNova and ModelRun (2-2.5x price, no faster).
